authorization.basis: user explicitly approved the constrained PKG_B_ATR_EXECUTION_STOP research variant on 2026-09-24
constraints_imposed_by_the_authorization: signal uses only the first legal ARMED day and data known as of T
the initial execution stop is fixed at entry and is never backfilled from confirmation-day parameters
no confirmation-day Entry Zone and no confirmation-day T1 is applied at the earlier entry
the existing 5% and 2R gates are not modified and are not used as pre-confirmation admission gates for the experimental group
no new chase, trend, target-space or ATR-cap filter and no parameter search
pre-confirmation maximum waiting window fixed at 20 sessions (entry session counts as session 1)
baseline and stress spread/slippage assumptions fixed at 10bp and 25bp per side
portfolio drawdown is not estimable and must not be fabricated

prior_evidence.immutability: the first-stage result and the A/B/C package definitions are evidence records and are not rewritten by this protocol
prior_evidence.sample_exposure_disclosure: this sample is symbol-level and lifecycle-level independent of Development, but its calendar window overlaps the Development window and it was already used for the first-stage candidate decision; it is NOT a fresh untouched out-of-sample set and no Final OOS is accessed

sample.no_replacement_rule: no symbol, provider, adjustment payload or window may be replaced, extended or re-acquired for this study

cn_raw_payload.fallback_if_absent: limit-price flags are reported as LIMIT_DATA_UNAVAILABLE and the trade stays in the primary result with the flag recorded

denominator.common_denominator: the unchanged first-stage cohort of 2291 causal Wave2 anchor contexts (CN 1081 / US 1210), including FAILED, never-CONFIRMED, screened-out, non-triggered, non-executable, structurally invalidated and right-censored rows
denominator.no_survivorship: no filtering on later confirmation, price path, MFE/MAE, return, target reach or any outcome label
denominator.reported_per_identity: signalled, admitted, model-executable, realized exit, censored and missing counts are reported per market and per identity

A_FULL_INCUMBENT.role: full current SETUP_01 Decision, executed as the production T-day plan plus exact T+1 OPEN execution
A_FULL_INCUMBENT.event: first CONFIRMED event per lifecycle (production is_new_confirmed_event_as_of)
A_FULL_INCUMBENT.plan: production evaluate_setup01_decision: entry zone [H1, H1 + 0.5*ATR14(T)], execution stop = confirmed Wave2 low - 0.5*ATR14(T), T1/T2/T3 from T-known confirmed swing highs above the planned entry plus frozen Wave-1 Fib extension ratios
A_FULL_INCUMBENT.admission_gates: existing 5% gross target-upside gate, existing 2R gate, entry-zone and gap rules; unchanged
A_FULL_INCUMBENT.entry: exact next market session OPEN, only when the production executor classifies EXECUTED
A_FULL_INCUMBENT.management: common research management policy with the frozen T-day targets, execution stop and 1R

B_FIRST_CONFIRMED_STRUCTURAL.role: first-CONFIRMED structural timing comparator; NOT a formal tradable plan
B_FIRST_CONFIRMED_STRUCTURAL.event: first CONFIRMED event per lifecycle, identical to A
B_FIRST_CONFIRMED_STRUCTURAL.admission_gates: none; the structural timing comparator ignores the entry zone, the 5% gate and the 2R gate
B_FIRST_CONFIRMED_STRUCTURAL.entry: exact next market session OPEN whenever that OPEN exists and is finite and positive, and the T-day execution stop and structural low exist
B_FIRST_CONFIRMED_STRUCTURAL.not_evaluable: when the T-day Decision has no ATR or no structural geometry the row is reported as NOT_EVALUABLE_NO_ATR and kept in the denominator
B_FIRST_CONFIRMED_STRUCTURAL.management: common research management policy with the same T-day targets, execution stop and 1R as A
B_FIRST_CONFIRMED_STRUCTURAL.reporting_rule: B results must never be presented as the incumbent strategy or as an approved entry rule

C_ARMED_CONSTRAINED_PKG_B.signal: first legal ARMED day of the lifecycle (causal primary/alternate WAVE_2_TO_3 context with all three Swing anchors confirmed, close >= wave2_low + 0.5*(wave1_peak - wave2_low) and close <= wave1_peak), using only data known as of T
C_ARMED_CONSTRAINED_PKG_B.initial_execution_stop: S = confirmed Wave 2 low - 0.5 * ATR14(T), computed from the signal-day prefix only
C_ARMED_CONSTRAINED_PKG_B.initial_1R: entry - S, frozen at entry for the life of the position; never recomputed from confirmation-day parameters
C_ARMED_CONSTRAINED_PKG_B.entry: exact next market session OPEN after the signal day
admission_requirements: the exact next session bar exists for the symbol and carries a finite positive OPEN
the producing Wave2 lifecycle has not terminated before that entry bar
C_ARMED_CONSTRAINED_PKG_B.no_confirmation_day_geometry_at_entry: the confirmation-day Entry Zone, confirmation-day T1/T2/T3 and confirmation-day execution stop are never applied to the earlier entry
C_ARMED_CONSTRAINED_PKG_B.diagnostic_only: the position of the OPEN relative to H1 is recorded as a diagnostic and never used as an admission filter

pre_confirmation_exit_policy.applies_to: C only, from the entry bar until the session after the first legal CONFIRMED close
pre_confirmation_exit_policy.execution_stop: fixed S; gap at OPEN at or below S exits at that OPEN, otherwise a session LOW at or below S exits at S
pre_confirmation_exit_policy.structural_and_lifecycle_exit: a close-based Wave2 structural invalidation or any causal termination of the producing Setup lifecycle (structural invalidation, wave-scenario invalidation, weekly downtrend, ABC primary context, context no longer eligible or screened out) forces an exit at the next valid session OPEN
pre_confirmation_exit_policy.timeout: maximum waiting window of 20 sessions with the entry session counted as session 1; if the lifecycle has not confirmed by the close of session 20 the position is closed at the next valid session OPEN
pre_confirmation_exit_policy.no_future_targets: no confirmation-day target is used before the first CONFIRMED close and an intraday touch of H1 never creates a synthetic take-profit trade
pre_confirmation_exit_policy.censoring: if the frozen series ends before the scheduled exit the row is right-censored and is excluded from realized trade economics; a separate mark-to-market valuation sensitivity may be reported but must not be mixed into realized results

confirmation_handoff.trigger: first legal CONFIRMED close of the producing lifecycle
confirmation_handoff.targets: the formal confirmation-day target set computed by production evaluate_setup01_decision for that confirmation event (T-known confirmed swing highs above the planned entry plus frozen Wave-1 Fib extension ratios)
confirmation_handoff.start: management uses that target set from the next session onward, never on the confirmation bar itself
confirmation_handoff.unchanged_geometry: entry price, initial execution stop and initial 1R stay exactly as frozen at entry
confirmation_handoff.gates: the confirmation-day 5% and 2R gates are new-entry admission conditions only and never cancel or eject an already open research position
confirmation_handoff.invalid_target_fallback: if the confirmation-day target set is empty the position continues under stop, structural and lifecycle rules only and is flagged NO_VALID_TARGET_AT_CONFIRMATION
confirmation_handoff.unavailable_decision_fallback: if no production Decision can be matched to the confirmation event the row is flagged CONFIRMATION_DECISION_UNAVAILABLE and continues without a target exit

common_management_policy.fixed_geometry: entry price, initial execution stop S0 and initial 1R are frozen at entry; the active stop never moves down and is never widened
per_session_check_order: if OPEN <= active stop: exit at OPEN (EXIT_GAP_BELOW_STOP)
else if LOW <= active stop: exit at active stop (EXIT_STOP_TRIGGERED)
else if a target set is active and HIGH >= T1: exit at T1 (EXIT_TARGET_T1_REACHED, research-only assumption)
else if close <= confirmed Wave 2 low: structural exit pending, execute at the next session OPEN (EXIT_STRUCTURAL_INVALIDATION)
common_management_policy.same_bar_ordering: the execution stop always takes precedence over a simultaneous target touch, and a gap through the stop is processed before any other condition on that session

target_exit_assumption.difference_from_frozen_position_manageme: docs/POSITION_MANAGEMENT_EXIT_V1.md treats targets as diagnostic state and never auto-sells
target_exit_assumption.justification: the authorization pre-registers a stop-versus-target ordering for the confirmation-phase target set, so a full exit at the nearest formal target (T1) is registered before any outcome is read
target_exit_assumption.conservatism: T1 is the nearest target and a gap above T1 is recorded at T1, never at the better OPEN

declared_differences_from_frozen_positio: targets are exit triggers here and diagnostic-only in the frozen protocol

no MFE profit-protection floor and no confirmed-higher-low stop raises are applied: both frozen rules reference confirmation-day geometry and ATR that a pre-confirmation entry cannot use without backfilling, and applying them only after confirmation would make the exit engine state-dependent between identities
no Wave5 context or high-risk advisory flags are computed; they never change an exit decision in the frozen protocol
none of these differences changes any production module, and the same policy is applied to A, B and C so that differences between identities come from admission and timing, not from exit bookkeeping

shared_alternative_policy.definition: identical to the primary policy with the target exit removed, so positions exit only at the stop, on structural invalidation, on pre-confirmation lifecycle failure or timeout, or are censored
shared_alternative_policy.reporting_rule: reported for all three identities as a pre-registered sensitivity; it is never used to select a favourable reading

cost_model.scenario_source: explicit research assumption supplied with the 2026-09-24 authorization; not observed historical quotes and never adjusted after results

CN.transfer_fee_bound: documented omission bounded by about 0.01% of notional per side if applicable
CN.limit_detection: an OPEN within 0.005 of round(preclose * (1 +/- price_limit_pct), 2) is flagged MODEL_ONLY_LIMIT_AT_OPEN and kept in the primary result
CN.suspension_rule: a missing next-session bar is a skip; a zero or non-finite volume prevents model execution

US.spread_source: no quote or spread data exists in the frozen payload; the spread component is the registered scenario bp and is reported as a modelling assumption

cost_model.cost_application: buy cost = OPEN * (slippage + commission) + minimum fee per order; sell cost = EXIT * (slippage + commission + sell taxes and fees) + minimum fee per order + per-share sell fee; gross and net results are reported separately

position_sizing.quantity: floor(risk_capital / |entry - initial stop| / lot_size) * lot_size, computed once at entry and never re-sized
position_sizing.not_executable_rule: a quantity below one lot is reported as NOT_EXECUTABLE_AT_RESEARCH_BUDGET and excluded from realized economics
position_sizing.portfolio_semantics: the existing account risk and portfolio capacity semantics are unchanged and are not applied here; only single-trade feasibility is computed
position_sizing.capital_occupation: notional = quantity * entry, position-days = number of sessions the position is open, capital-time = notional * position-days, reported as exposure only

metrics.primary: mean net R per realized trade, per identity, per market, under the BASELINE cost scenario
per_identity_per_market: signal, admission, model-executable, realized, censored and missing counts with reason breakdowns
mean, median, p10, p25, p75, p90 of net R and net return
share of losing trades, share of trades at or below -1R, worst trade and tail loss
gross versus net comparison and the BASELINE versus STRESS difference
composition by eventual status (LATER_CONFIRMED, FAILED, NEVER_CONFIRMED) and by resolution
time-half and depth-band strata, symbol concentration and count-leading-symbol removal
metrics.opportunity_cost: only exposure is reported; no alternative-trade model is registered, so missed-return figures are never fabricated
metrics.portfolio: portfolio drawdown is NOT_ESTIMABLE because no account-level concurrency, budget or holdings path is modelled; event-level sums are reported as sums of event-level net R and are never presented as a portfolio equity curve

uncertainty.clustering: symbol-clustered bootstrap: symbols are resampled with replacement within each market and every event of a sampled symbol is kept together
statistics: mean net R per realized trade
difference of mean net R versus C
uncertainty.reported_interval: 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of the resampled statistic
uncertainty.strata: time half by market-session ordinal, depth band, market, and the drop-count-leading-symbol and drop-censored variants
uncertainty.paired_subset: lifecycles where both an incumbent trade and an experimental trade were realized are reported descriptively as a paired subset

floors.floor_derivation: conservative fractions of the first-stage executable counts (CN 461, US 525); failing a floor yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never NOT_SUPPORTED

supported_requires_all: floors satisfied in CN and US
mean net R per realized trade of C is strictly greater than A and strictly greater than B in both markets
the pooled symbol-clustered bootstrap 95% interval for (C - B) and for (C - A) excludes zero with a strictly positive lower bound
the pooled point estimates of (C - B) and (C - A) stay strictly positive under the STRESS cost scenario and after dropping the count-leading symbol of each market
decision_rules.not_supported_rule: if the pooled point estimate of (C - B) or of (C - A) is at or below zero the classification is NOT_SUPPORTED
decision_rules.insufficient_evidence_rule: floors, censoring bounds, missing confirmation Decisions, cost or fill assumptions that flip the sign of a pooled point estimate, or an interval that contains zero while the point estimates stay positive yield INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
decision_rules.no_post_hoc_rule_change: a failed or insufficient classification is reported as-is and cannot be re-run with new thresholds, new symbols, a longer window, another exit policy or additional strata
decision_rules.claim_boundary: even a supported classification authorizes only an application for a the next independent execution validation stage; it authorizes no production rule, Paper ledger, state write, Sheet write or broker path

stopping_rules: sample, protocol or replay hash mismatch -> stop with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and keep the diagnostics
any identity unable to reproduce its first-stage counts on the common denominator -> stop with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
leakage, non-causal signal data, same-bar fill or later-bar substitution detected -> stop, report the violation and publish no economic classification
no sample replacement, no window extension, no parameter or exit search after the first result
out_of_scope: production rule change of any kind
Paper ledgers, production state, Sheets writes or broker orders
Final OOS or any formal validation set
portfolio construction, concurrency, drawdown or equity curves
forbidden: modifying Wave, Setup, Entry, Target, Stop, 5%, 2R, Risk, T->T+1 or Position Management semantics in production code
using confirmation-day geometry to filter the early entry
searching exit, timeout, cost or filter parameters after reading results
claiming broker or real fills from model fills
mixing the US production data-quality repair with this research

outputs.event_detail: compact aggregate, per-identity and per-market distributions plus reason counts; no raw bars, no private holdings
